create_camera_intrinsics: create an Intrinsics dataclass with a camera matrix and distortion parameters for a robotics vision pipeline
create_camera_extrinsics: create an Extrinsics dataclass with position and quaternion for a camera in the world frame
create_camera_params: create a Camera dataclass with width, height, intrinsics, and extrinsics for a robotics vision setup
create_color_range: create a ColorRange dataclass with lower and upper numpy arrays to define a YUV color cuboid
create_position_limit: create a PositionLimit dataclass with lower and upper bounds to define a Cartesian workspace cuboid
